newsitem.title: CHILE: AIRLINE LANCHILE TO ISSUE ADRS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: AIRLINE LANCHILE TO ISSUE ADRS - REPORT.

text.p: Chile's largest airline LanChile is planning a $280 million capital increase with $200 million worth of shares to be sold abroad via the American Depositary Receipt (ADR) mechanism, said newspaper El Mercurio Tuesday.
The paper, quoting unnamed sources close to company, said the capital increase would take place in October.
LanChile officials were not immediately available for comment.
Funds from the operation, much larger than the $70 million capital increase originally planned by stockholders, would be used to modernize LanChile's air fleet.
The new increase would have to be approved at a shareholders meeting August 27.
The airline, which is controlled by four Chilean groups including Cueto and Pinera, has announced plans to invest $600 million over the next three years in upgrading its aircraft.
